description: Suspicious or unauthorized login attempts to a system

tasks_template.description: Automated search for IOCs in MISP and preliminary scoring

subtasks.description: Search for related indicators of compromise in MISP.
Run preliminary scoring on the incoming alert.

tasks_template.title: Automated analysis from incoming alert

tasks_template.description: Review authentication logs, network logs, and system logs to identify the scope of the suspicious activity. Search Wazuh for follow-on success logins or lateral movement.

subtasks.description: Review authentication and system logs for the affected account.
Search Wazuh for successful logins or signs of lateral movement.

tasks_template.title: Log Review and Correlation

tasks_template.description: Contact the affected user to verify login attempts. Determine if the user recognizes the activity and gather additional context about their account usage patterns.

subtasks.description: Contact the user and confirm whether they initiated the login activity.
Document the user's account usage patterns and any recent changes.

tasks_template.title: User Interview and Verification

tasks_template.description: Implement containment measures including password resets, session termination, and account monitoring. Block suspicious IP addresses if necessary and implement additional security controls.

subtasks.description: Reset passwords and terminate active sessions for the affected account.
Block suspicious source IP addresses at the perimeter or identity provider.

tasks_template.title: Containment and Remediation

tasks_template.description: Document all findings, actions taken, and recommendations. Create incident report and update security team. Identify lessons learned and preventive measures.

subtasks.description: Draft and attach the final incident report.
Log agreed follow-up actions and preventive measures for tracking.

tasks_template.title: Documentation and Reporting
